column2: [intro]
When I was young, at school,
I thought I was a genius, so cool.
Without cracking a book, I played the role
Of the one who knew it all, I’d extol.
I have a visual memory,
In my mind, everything's so clear,
I see the colors, the details too,
It’s my superpower, and it's true.
One day, I lost my keys,
I searched high and low, with ease.
But suddenly, it came to me,
I knew exactly where they’d be, quite a spree!
I have a visual memory,
In my mind, everything's so clear,
I see the colors, the details too,
It’s my superpower, and it’s true.
